hitbox.broad_phase: actor XYZ plus +0x64/+0x66/+0x68 versus player Y-7360, all divided by 32, radius actor+0x6A plus 250
hitbox.narrow_phase: pose-indexed oriented ellipsoid from actor+0x74, also expanded by 250

ordinary_damage.horizontal_source: collision vector normalized by 0x80060284 then quarter-scaled

family_law: damage amount, timer, and launch are resident-global; family variation is actor hitbox data and eligibility flags
